pages.text: $(l)Oil wells$()$(br)Deserts (the biomes where desert pyramids can spawn) sometimes hold an $(item)oil well$(): on average once every $(item)500 chunks$(). It is a pillar of crude oil rising from a deposit at Y -64 all the way to roughly $(item)70 to 80 blocks above the ground$(), visible from very far away.

An oil well is free crude oil for a bucket or a pump, and its base is an ordinary deposit you can tap with a pumpjack later.$(br2)$(l)Fossilstone$()$(br)Fossilstone is a dark stone that only generates next to oil: around the bottom of deposit columns and in patches along the shaft of an oil well.

$(li)It is extremely tough: hardness $(item)100$(), twice that of obsidian, and blast resistance $(item)1200$().$(li)Any pickaxe drops it, but it takes a long time to break.$(br2)When a tunnel or a cave near bedrock runs into fossilstone, crude oil is right next to you. Mine around it, or simply build your pipe column beside it.
